title: Accelerating Intra-Node GPU Communication: A Performance Model for Multi-Path Transfers
problem: GPU-to-GPU intra-node communication bottleneck in MPI applications; unclear how to optimally distribute P2P transfers across multiple communication paths.
motivation: Multi-path GPU communication (via NVLink, PCIe, etc.) can improve throughput if routed optimally; MPI+UCX currently lacks guidance for path selection.
method: Performance model for intra-node multi-path GPU communication: considers link bandwidth, pipeline overhead, stream synchronization to identify optimal path distribution for P2P transfers.
key_novelty: Analytical performance model for multi-path GPU communication that accurately predicts optimal configurations with <6% error.
contributions: Performance model for multi-path GPU-to-GPU communication
Increased throughput via intelligent path distribution
primary_theme: Performance model for optimal multi-path intra-node GPU communication
